change: Extend the existing native-adoption module with evidence-row types and a pure per-leg push-outcome summary. Keep the frozen D011 adoption summary, target and rater unchanged.

tests.sourceQualification: Captured Vite pre-transform hashes for both named files match current raw bytes.
tests.ledgerScope: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS was omitted. Check the authoritative ledger scope before binding this run as plan acceptance.

typecheck.scope: Two named files; three cross legs clean, followed by full operator-core fallback when the service declined a 10304-file dependency closure.

newCases: Independent per-leg and per-outcome denominators, with null rates for unmeasured outcomes.
Open turn windows contribute neither positive nor negative outcome evidence.
Exact workspace and half-open time-window isolation, invalid timestamps excluded, repeated ledger ids counted once.
Invalid windows, missing ledger identity and conflicting evidence are refused.

limits: Only the pure summary is implemented and qualified here. No live ledger reader, outcome measurement, registered instrument or new rubric criterion is claimed.
The push ledger records server-issued hook responses; confirmed client receipt and attention are not measured.
identity_hook_turns stores only the current random turn UUID, so it cannot alone reconstruct historical turn windows.
The existing rows preserve cited paths and suggested tests. Only grep-leg subjects preserve symbol identity; other same-symbol grep outcomes must remain unknown until supported by persisted evidence.
This focused dirty-source verification is neither a full loaded-module census nor final release acceptance.
